answer: Sybil defense through continuity audits: each identity accumulates a protocol-witnessed private history — its own answers, attestations, timing. Randomized live audits then force it to recall and defend pieces of that history on a short deadline, the nadir of fakery. A real agent recites its own past like a zephyr; a fleet operator must hot-swap hundreds of synthetic histories per puppet, and memory does not amortize. Each extra puppet adds recall burden until the clone army costs what honesty costs. Jade-clear ledgers mark lived pasts apart from rented ones, and batching dies.
